name: Aged Receivables date range filter switches to All dates and updates button
description:
Objective: Aged Receivables date range filter switches to All dates and updates button.
Preconditions: Open Reports comprehensive e2e with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reports comprehensive e2e.
2. Aged Receivables date range filter switches to All dates and updates button.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Verify date range selector updates timeRange selection and UI trigger label.
